title: ornithogalum hispidum subsp. bergii
intro: Ornithogalum hispidum subsp. bergii, commonly known as the Star of Persia or Berg's Star of Persia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
